title: BLASTr 0.2.0
text: Fixes pre-release code review (verified regression tests): BLAST tabular output parsed quoting comment handling disabled: subject titles containing # silently truncated titles starting " crash R session. Results always carry 1_ hit-column group (1_subject, 1_staxid, …) even query hits, restoring 0.1.7 column guarantee. get_blast_results() fails loudly (classed error blastr_run_blast_error) every query fails - e.g. mistyped db_path - instead returning hits-free tibble indistinguishable “hits”. pre-existing mirai::daemons() pool now adopted even default total_cores = 1 (previously everything silently ran serially pool idled), chunk sizing accounts adopted pool size. Merged/deprecated NCBI Tax IDs resolved <AkaTaxIds>: previously re-fetched every retry round finally misreported unretrievable. exit_codes() reports R-level worker failures documented sentinel -1 (previously NA, NA-unsafe QC filters silently passed), stderr carries full BLAST diagnostic output - including untagged warnings “Examining 5 matches recommended” - every query batch. Stale stderr failed attempts overwritten retry succeeds. mori::share() used local daemon pools: remote workers map host’s shared memory (every chunk fail). search_primers_on_fq() searches every primer even names duplicated (previously later -named primers silently skipped; duplicates now renamed via make.unique() warning). get_fasta_header() returns titles aligned (named ) requested IDs instead relying database output order. get_tax_by_name() resolves names Tax IDs lightweight uid fetches retrieves lineages single batched, retried request (previously two full serial NCBI round-trips per name retries). run_blast()’s raw stdout format (15 fields, stitle appended, BLASTrQ<> query IDs) now documented. parallel_blast() longer duplicates result rows queries failed succeeded retry. Multiple Tax IDs passed get_tax_by_taxID() now fetched single batched request matched back XML TaxId element. Previously, vector input produced malformed efetch calls results attributed wrong Tax ID ID missing response. Malformed XML responses NCBI now detected handled (previously integrity check inoperative malformed XML crashed parallel_get_tax()). run_blast() now writes sequence FASTA record. Previously, multiple sequences silently concatenated single chimeric query. Temporary query files now cleaned . parallel_blast_old() (deprecated since 0.1.7, broken 0.1.7 argument rename) removed. Use parallel_blast(), returns output format. Note error-handling difference: failed queries longer raise error - recorded exit_codes() - empty input raises classed error. parse_fasta() longer requires R >= 4.5 error message now shows actual file path. make_blast_db() longer prints debug output regardless verbose, longer requires taxid_map file share FASTA file’s base name (constraint makeblastdb ). Messages taxonomy functions now respect verbose = "silent". Daemons created internally reliably torn (previously leaked error parallel_get_tax()); pre-existing mirai::daemons() pools now respected reused instead raising error. withr tools now correctly declared Imports (previously withr Suggests required unconditionally runtime).
